Commanders.desc: First reroll each round costs 1 less gold.
Fighters starting without adjacent allies gain 10% attack speed.
Your highest-attack fighter gains 3% attack speed per basic attack, up to 24%.
Gain 1 extra gold after each NPC encounter.
Once per fighter, below 30% HP restores 15% HP over 3 seconds.
